module: Flowgraph node "Delivery Finished" (category repeat_instant, delivery). Detects the end of the delivery (all objectives reached or manual end via the quick menu). Input pins: flow. Outputs: finished (single pulse), isActive, failed, failReason (empty string on success). Uses isActive, isFinished, isFailed and getFailReason of the freeformDelivery module.

work.desc: If flow is active, compares the finished state with the previous state to emit finished only once and fills failed/failReason.
